expectations.text: Creates a new record instead of rewriting the decision in ADR-0003
expectations.evidence: Adds new ADR-00NN, keeps ADR-0003 and changes only status

expectations.text: Marks ADR-0003 as superseded and links the old and new records to each other
expectations.evidence: "Superseded by ADR-00NN" and "Supersedes: ADR-0003" (planned, not applied)

expectations.text: Uses or asks for the next free record number
expectations.evidence: "new ADR with the next free number (ADR-00NN)" placeholder only; weak

expectations.text: Leaves the new record Proposed until the user agrees, or asks for the user's confirmation
expectations.evidence: New ADR drafted "Status: Accepted"; no confirmation asked on acceptance
